items.title: Section: The Moment of Conception, Seen From the Inside

items.zh: 依此諸緣故，煩惱現行。問：於彼彼界結生相續彼彼身中，當言全界一切煩惱皆結生耶？為不全耶？答：當言全，非不全。何以故？若未離欲，於自生處方得受生，非離欲故。又未離欲者，諸煩惱品所有麁重隨縛自身，亦能為彼異身生因。由是因緣，當知一切煩惱皆結生相續。又將受生時，於自體上貪愛現行，於男於女若愛若恚亦互現行。又疑現行。彼作是思：此男此女，今為與我共行事不？又於內外我我所見及我慢等皆亦現行。由此因緣，當知一切煩惱皆得結生相續。
items.en: It is according to these conditions that affliction manifests. Question: when linked in rebirth-continuity within a body belonging to a given realm, should it be said that the entire body of affliction belonging to that realm links along, or not entirely? Answer: it should be said entirely, not partially. Why is this so? Because one not yet free of desire is reborn precisely where their own desire binds them, not where they are already free of it. Also, one not yet free of desire carries the coarse-heaviness of every affliction bound to their own body, which becomes the cause for a different body's arising. For this reason, it should be known that every affliction links one to rebirth-continuity. Also, at the time of taking rebirth, self-love manifests towards one's own body, and towards the man and the woman, attraction or aversion manifests by turns. Doubt also manifests, thinking: is this man, this woman, now truly the one acting together with me? Self-view, self-belonging-view, and self-conceit, both inner and outer, manifest as well. For this reason, it should be known that every affliction links a being to rebirth-continuity.

items.title: Section: Seven Ways a Being Is Linked to Their Own Rebirth

items.zh: 復次，結生相續略有七種。一、纏及隨眠結生相續，謂諸異生。二、唯隨眠結生相續，謂見聖迹。三、正知入胎結生相續，謂轉輪王。四、正知入住結生相續，謂諸獨覺。五、於一切位不失正念結生相續，謂諸菩薩。六、業所引發結生相續，謂除菩薩結生相續。七、智所引發結生相續，謂諸菩薩。
items.en: Moreover, rebirth-linking is, in brief, of seven kinds. First, rebirth-linking through both manifestation and latent tendency, belonging to ordinary beings. Second, rebirth-linking through latent tendency alone, belonging to those who have seen the noble footprint. Third, rebirth-linking through conscious entry into the womb, belonging to a wheel-turning monarch. Fourth, rebirth-linking through conscious entry and abiding, belonging to solitary awakened ones. Fifth, rebirth-linking without loss of mindfulness at any stage, belonging to bodhisattvas. Sixth, rebirth-linking driven by karma, belonging to all except the bodhisattva's own rebirth-linking. Seventh, rebirth-linking driven by wisdom, belonging to bodhisattvas.

items.title: Section: Affliction Defilement's Own Closing Verse — And Karma Defilement Opens

items.zh: 又有引無義利結生相續，謂即業所引發結生相續。又有能引義利結生相續，謂智所引發結生相續。如是總說結生相續，或七、或九。復次，於此處所，有餘一切順前句、順後句及四句等如理決擇文，更不復現。後嗢拕南曰：業、相、事、樂等、不善等、及斷、所緣、與現行、續生、最為後。如是已說煩惱雜染決擇。業雜染決擇，我今當說。如先所說業雜染義，當知此業亦由五相建立差別。
items.en: There is also rebirth-linking that leads to no benefit, namely karma-driven rebirth-linking. There is also rebirth-linking able to lead to benefit, namely wisdom-driven rebirth-linking. Thus, in total, rebirth-linking is said to be of seven, or of nine kinds. Moreover, in this place, all remaining deciding-discernment texts following the patterns of narrower-to-broader, broader-to-narrower, and the four alternatives do not appear again. The closing verse says: the generation of karma, the marks, the real and unreal objects, the correspondence with feeling, and the rest; the unwholesome and the rest, and severing; its objects referenced and its manifestation; rebirth-linking last of all. Thus the deciding discernment of affliction defilement has been explained. The deciding discernment of karma defilement shall now be explained. As already explained regarding the meaning of karma defilement, it should be known that this karma too is established through five aspects of difference.

items.zh: 謂根本業道所攝身語意業，及彼方便、後起所攝諸業。如先所說不善業道，名根本業道所攝不善身語意業。

items.title: Section: Five Factors for a Complete Act of Killing — From a Defiled Mind to the Deed's Completion

items.zh: 云何建立彼殺生等不善業道自相？謂染污心起彼欲樂，即於是處彼業現行而得究竟，當知總名殺生等一切業道自相。染污心者，謂貪者貪所蔽，瞋者瞋所蔽，癡者癡所蔽。
items.en: How is the own-mark of the unwholesome karma-path of killing and the rest established? A defiled mind arises together with the wish and intention to act, and precisely with respect to that object, the deed manifests and reaches completion — this in total is called the own-mark of the karma-path of killing and all such deeds. A defiled mind means that one of greed is obscured by greed, one of hatred is obscured by hatred, and one of delusion is obscured by delusion.

items.title: Section: When a Killing Is Not Quite a Killing

items.zh: 設有染污心，不起彼欲樂，雖於是處彼業現行而得究竟，然此惡業非是圓滿業道所攝。設有染污心及起彼欲樂，而顛倒心，設於餘事彼業現行而得究竟，此業亦非圓滿業道所攝。設有染污心及起彼欲樂，即於是處業不現行而得究竟，此業亦非圓滿業道所攝。設有染污心及起彼欲樂，即於是處彼業現行而不究竟，此業亦非圓滿業道所攝。若有染污心及起彼欲樂，即於是處彼業現行而得究竟，具一切支，此業乃名圓滿業道所攝。由此略說業道自相，一切不善業道自相應隨決了。
items.en: Suppose there is a defiled mind and the arisen wish, and with respect to that object, the deed does not manifest, yet completion is reached — this deed is also not included among the fully complete karma-path. Suppose there is a defiled mind and the arisen wish, and with respect to that object, the deed manifests, yet does not reach completion — this deed is also not included among the fully complete karma-path. If there is a defiled mind and the arisen wish, and with respect to that object, the deed manifests and reaches completion, possessing every factor, this deed is called included among the fully complete karma-path. By this brief account of the own-mark of the karma-path, every unwholesome karma-path's own-mark should accordingly be determined.

items.title: Section: A More Detailed Five — The Object and the Four Kinds of Perception

items.zh: 復次，若廣建立十惡業道自性差別，復由五相。何等為五？一、事，二、想，三、欲樂，四、煩惱，五、方便究竟。事者，一一業道各別決定所依處事。或有情數、或非有情數，隨其所應，十惡業道依之而轉。想者，有四。謂於彼非彼想，非於彼彼想，於彼彼想，非於彼非彼想。
items.en: Moreover, if the specific varieties of the ten unwholesome karma-paths are established in more detail, there are five aspects again. What are the five? First, the object. Second, the perception. Third, the wish. Fourth, the affliction. Fifth, means and completion. The object is the particular basis each individual karma-path specifically depends upon, whether sentient or not sentient, each of the ten unwholesome karma-paths turning according to it. Perception is of four kinds: perceiving what is the object as not the object, perceiving what is not the object as the object, perceiving what is the object as the object, and perceiving what is not the object as correctly not the object.

blocks.text: How affliction links a being to rebirth, and then a new topic: karma, beginning with the ten courses of action and what makes an act of killing complete.
Master Cháng Bǎi: in whatever realm one is reborn, the whole set of that realm's afflictions causes the linking; sūtras often say craving alone, but that is a shorthand.
Master Cháng Bǎi: ordinary beings take a new life through both active affliction and seeds. Noble bodhisattvas are reborn by wisdom and vow, coming to save beings and uphold the Dharma.
Master Cháng Bǎi: 業道 means unwholesome karma becomes a road to the lower realms. (Untranslated, 0630a08: what counts as the root, preparation, and aftermath of the ten unwholesome courses.)
All five must be complete: the object, perception, intention, affliction, and the deed carried through to completion. Master Cháng Bǎi: "that object" is the target, a person or animal.
Master Cháng Bǎi: one does not mistake the target, nor strike, yet the other dies; or the deed does not succeed: lacking any of the five, it is not a complete killing.
Master Cháng Bǎi: taking A as not-A, and not-A as A, are distorted perceptions.
The analysis of killing is legal in its precision. Its purpose is not to find loopholes but to show that intention, not just outcome, makes karma.

quiz.q: The English has "according to whether one will be male or female." What is wrong?
options: nothing: it means one's own future sex, the lecture not mentioning parents
"attraction" should be "hunger"
"reciprocally" should be "never"
男 and 女 are the objects of love and aversion, the parents; the English makes them one's own sex
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: if one's future self is female, love arises towards the father and aversion towards the mother. Male and female are the parents. The English keeps the idea of one's own sex but loses the objects, even though the next sentence's "this man, this woman" depends on them.

quiz.q: At rebirth-linking, is it all the realm's afflictions or not?
options: not entirely: only craving links, as the sūtras say, the treatise stressing partiality, as the lecture holds
none: rebirth is unrelated to affliction
half
entirely: one not free of desire is born there, all afflictions linking
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: in whatever realm one is reborn, the entire afflictions of that realm cause the linking; sūtras often say craving alone is origin, but that is abbreviated; at rebirth the other afflictions of that ground continue too. The English follows this.

quiz.q: How do the first and second rebirth-linkings differ?
options: ordinary beings by seeds alone, unaware of affliction; noble ones by both
ordinary beings by both; those who have seen, conceptual ones severed, by innate seeds only
both by vow
both by wisdom
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: ordinary beings take a new life through both manifest affliction and its seeds; for those with conceptual afflictions severed, innate seeds of self-view are not yet wholly gone, and so they come back to the desire realm. "Seen the noble path" here differs from "noble footprint" in §25 for one term.

quiz.q: How do wheel-turning monarchs, solitary realisers, and bodhisattvas link rebirth?
options: knowing entry; knowing entry and abiding; never losing mindfulness at any stage
never losing mindfulness; knowing entry; entry and abiding, the monarch's merit being greatest
all unknowing
all spontaneous, none entering a womb
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: for one who will attain solitary realisation in this life, entering and abiding in the womb are both known; "all stages" means entry, abiding, and exit, fully clear with no loss of mindfulness. The three form an ascending scale. The English is accurate.

quiz.q: How do karma-driven and wisdom-driven linking relate, and how are seven or nine counted?
options: bodhisattvas too are karma-driven
the nine abodes
the nine grounds
bodhisattvas by wisdom and vow bring benefit; adding two to seven makes nine
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: noble bodhisattvas are reborn by wisdom and vow, a linking that brings benefit, coming to save beings and uphold the Dharma; nine means the seven plus the two, linking without and with benefit. Karma and wisdom are the deciding pair.

quiz.q: The English has "karma's generation, its marks, its objects." What is wrong with the subject?
options: it closes affliction defilement; marks, objects, and feeling are affliction's, and "its" assigns them to karma
no problem: the verse announces karma defilement, all items being karma's, as the lecture says, unrelated to affliction
the problem is "verse"
the problem is "last of all"
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: 業 refers to affliction generating karma through force and discrimination; 相 to affliction's marks; 事 to afflictions with or without a real object. The verse sums up affliction defilement from §1 to §29. The English's "its" misassigns everything to karma.

quiz.q: What are the five factors of a karma-path's own-mark?
options: defiled mind, wish, that object, the deed manifesting, completion
greed, hatred, delusion, conceit, doubt
body, speech, mind, life, wealth
object, perception, wish, affliction, time
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: here five aspects must all be complete, none lacking; "that object" is the target, such as a person or animal; the deed manifesting is beginning to act, which is the means. The English "precisely with respect to that object" fits.

quiz.q: How does Master Cháng Bǎi explain the name karma-path and defiled mind?
options: karma-path means the Buddhist practice road, and defiled mind one arising when the body is unclean, unrelated to the veil of poisons
a career path
unwholesome karma is a road to evil destinies; the deluded are veiled, not grasping causality
a monastery's road
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: 業道 means unwholesome karma becomes a road to the three evil destinies; deluded persons, veiled by delusion, do not understand cause and effect and give rise to wrong view. The English "obscured" renders 蔽 well.

quiz.q: With defiled mind and wish, if no deed yet the person dies, or a deed without completion, is it a complete karma-path?
options: both are: motive alone makes a complete killing
neither: lacking any factor, it is not a complete path
the first is, the second not
the first is not, the second is
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: one does not mistake the target, nor strike, yet the other dies; or the deed does not fully succeed, lacking completion; lacking any of the five, it is not a complete path. The source has two further exclusions the English lacks, so §31 lists only part of the argument.

quiz.q: What five aspects detail the ten unwholesome paths?
options: body, speech, mind, greed, hatred, by the three karmas and affliction, perception and wish not included
three times, good, evil
object, perception, wish, affliction, means and completion
humans, gods, animals, ghosts, hells
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: adding perception gives five aspects, by which the nature of the ten paths is distinguished; the object may be sentient or not, and the ten rest on different objects. The next sections apply these five to each path in turn.

quiz.q: The English has "perceiving what is not the object as not the object" for 於彼非彼想. What is wrong?
options: nothing: the first and fourth are the same, repeated for emphasis, both undistorted per the lecture
"perceiving" should be "hearing"
"object" should be "subject"
it should be taking the object as not the object; it duplicates the fourth, a distorted perception becoming undistorted
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: the first takes A as not A, a distorted perception; the second takes not-A as A, also distorted; the fourth takes not-A as not A, undistorted. The English first item says what the fourth says. Two distorted and two undistorted perceptions are the point.
